items.title: Dumont Code
items.description: The desktop app is now Dumont Code: its own name, icon, bundle id and dumontcode:// scheme. opencode:// keeps working, because the server and CLI still emit those deep links.

items.title: Updates come from Dumont
items.description: The updater and the release notes you are reading both point at dumont.au. Nothing in the app can pull a build from an upstream host any more.

items.title: A Dumont theme, light and dark
items.description: Navy and teal, on by default, and built so light mode is the good one rather than an afterthought. Every upstream theme is still in the picker.

items.title: Signed and notarised
items.description: Apple Developer ID signed, notarised and stapled, so it opens on first launch with no trip through Privacy & Security.

items.title: Apple silicon and Intel
items.description: Separate arm64 and x64 downloads, both signed, both fed by the same update channel.
